message.content: In one of the discussions, RexxarRemar suggested a combination of Bluebells (Bluebell), Camellias (Camellia), and Tulips (Tulip) as a great combo for a vibrant and appealing garden. He highlighted that these flowers would complement each other well and attract butterflies, making the garden even more vibrant and attractive. RexxarRemar expressed his excitement about seeing the final result of these beautiful flowers in the garden.
